exact_results: For cubic incidence A, Ax=1 with x Boolean iff Az=0 with z=3x-1 in {-1,2}^n.
Each connected satisfiable component has size divisible by 3 and exactly n/3 coordinates z_i=2.
Rational nullity d gives exact O(2^d poly(n)) solution by free-coordinate enumeration and back-substitution.
Every cubic bipartite incidence matrix decomposes as A=P0+P1+P2; after normalization A=I+P+Q.
For triangular torus A_k=I+Sx+Sy, rational nullity is 0 if 3 does not divide k and 2 if 3 divides k.
For every k divisible by 3 there are explicit residue-class 1-in-3 witnesses, yielding an infinite satisfiable unbounded-treewidth Kettani counterfamily.
source_controls: Konig line-coloring theorem: every Delta-regular bipartite graph decomposes into Delta perfect matchings.

active_gate.target: Poly nonlocal contraction/solver for large-nullity (I+P+Q)z=0 with z in {-1,2}^n after all exact preprocessing islands.
